projects.name: Ky · desktop icon

tokenSources.onLight: Existing charcoal repurposed for light-background mark
tokenSources.background: Transparent portable symbol; desktop icon adds charcoal tile

rationale: New interpretation: the existing K becomes a cut key: its lower diagonal has two teeth, linking Ky to secret retrieval by alias.
The K silhouette retains the project initial; stepped lower arm is the memory cue. This is a local desktop derivative, not a claim of historical symbolism.
userDecisions: Preserve existing Ky brand where viable; authorized redesign if existing asset missing or unsuitable.
recommendations: Use the charcoal tile icon in Dock and UI; use bare mark on editorial surfaces. New path shape remains a proposal, not user-approved brand standard.
